title: Vendor
description: Supplier or vendor company that provides goods or services. Contains vendor contact information, location, category, performance rating, and active status for procurement and supply chain management.

id.description: Unique identifier for the vendor record

name.description: Official company name of the vendor or supplier

contact_person.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the vendor company

email.description: Primary business email address for vendor communications

phone.description: Primary business phone number for vendor inquiries

address.description: Street address of the vendor's primary business location

city.description: City where the vendor's business is located

category.description: Category or type of products/services the vendor provides (e.g., IT Services, Office Supplies, Manufacturing)

rating.description: Performance or quality rating of the vendor, typically on a scale of 1-5

active.description: Whether the vendor relationship is currently active and orders can be placed
